connector.name: Sri Lanka Payslip

connector.summary: Hosted at mypayslip.lk over streamable HTTP, also runs locally from the container image sri-lanka-payslip-mcp:2026.27.2. No credential is declared, and it reaches all 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the buddhima-jd3 account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: No credential is declared in the registry record. A hosted endpoint may still apply its own rate limits or sign in step.
